verdict.rationale: Parsec's own marketing documents a Teams API for automating deployment, pulling full audit logs, and reporting, so the product does offer programmatic control. That API is limited to the Teams plan and to admin, deployment and reporting tasks. The evidence never shows actual API reference docs, and probes for llms.txt, markdown API docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: an evidenced public API reference or spec, API coverage of core session and connection control, availability outside the Teams tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
